chapter: Tiger Rag and Mopah Blues explained
title: Tunes with no names: 'play some dirt'
summary: He says the band called tunes 'dirt', then they briefly discuss the vulgar language.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Tiger Rag didn't have a name?
No, see, outside of Hunyadi. They didn't even know how he called Hunyadi. They didn't know. They just said, play some Dirt.
You mean the people or the band? No, the band.
The folks in the band. Let's play some of the Dirt.
Man. No, they don't think it's law. No, I wouldn't put that in there. Every man has talked that way. You know, it only means he's talking straight forward, I think.
Wait a minute, I can't hear. No, one Dirt. Tiger Rag. We did go over Tiger Rag a little bit, but...
